info.title: MandiCast API
info.description: Daily mandi prices from AGMARKNET (Open Government Data Platform India, GODL-India) and 7/14-day price forecasts with measured accuracy. Forecasts are estimates, not guarantees.

get.description:
Mandis, by name. Filter by state, district, a commodity they report, a name substring, and whether the
latest forecast publication for the commodity includes them.

parameters.name: has_forecast

schema.description: Only mandis with (true) or without (false) a forecast for commodity_id in its latest publication
schema.title: Has Forecast

parameters.description: Only mandis with (true) or without (false) a forecast for commodity_id in its latest publication

get.description:
Daily history of one (commodity, mandi) series. Without `variety`/`grade`: the primary value of each day (one
row per day). With them: every reported row of that variety/grade.

Latest reported price of each mandi for a commodity, if it reported within `max_age_days` of the latest
arrival date of that commodity.

Modal prices of one commodity at 2–10 mandis on the dates when all of them reported (unflagged primary
values). Default range: the 90 days up to the latest report among them.
Descriptive statistics of recent prices. They describe the past and are not forecasts.

The latest published forecast for a series: one point per day for `horizon` days after the origin, with
80% and 90% ranges, which method served each day (model, or last value under the fallback rule), the served
method's measured hold-out accuracy, live accuracy so far, and warnings.

Whether a series passes the sufficiency rules (methodology §2), the statistics behind the decision, and
whether it is in the latest published forecast.
The production model of each commodity (or of one).

schema.title: Response Models Current V1 Models Current Get

get.description:
The walk-forward evaluation of this model's method: hold-out metrics against the last-price baseline and the
other models on the same points, by horizon and by quarter (generated from the evaluation files).

schema.title: Response Model Evaluation V1 Models  Version  Evaluation Get

get.description:
Every model version of a commodity (production, candidates, rejected, archived) with its gate outcome, and the
lifecycle events: registrations, promotions, rejections, rollbacks, fallbacks (newest first).

When data was last ingested, how recent it is per commodity, how many mandis stopped reporting, and the
latest forecast origin.

Operations view (methodology C10): live accuracy of published forecasts, the latest publication's fallback
decisions and drift, the production model and its gate, recent lifecycle events, and the missing-update checks
from the last monitor run.

Liveness and dependencies: database, Redis, production model artifacts. 503 if the database is down;
`degraded` if Redis is down (the API still serves, without shared cache and rate limits).

post.description: Exchange the one-time code from the bot's /login link for a session token (the code works once).

schema.title: Response List Alerts V1 Alerts Get

post.description:
Create an alert: price at or above / at or below a value (₹ per quintal), or the 7-day forecast moving by at
least a percentage from the last reported price.

get.description: Alert messages sent (or attempted) to me, newest first (kept 12 months).

schema.title: Response Alert History V1 Alerts History Get

delete.description: Delete my account, sessions, alerts and alert history, immediately.

method.title: Method
method.description: The method that served this horizon

wape.title: Wape
wape.description: Weighted absolute percentage error of the serving method on the hold-out year

baseline_wape.title: Baseline Wape
baseline_wape.description: Same, for the last reported price used as the forecast

interval_coverage.title: Interval Coverage
interval_coverage.description: Share of actual prices inside the model's 80% and 90% ranges on the hold-out year

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: exact, whitespace, apmc_suffix, state_rename or manual

model_modal_price.title: Model Modal Price
model_modal_price.description: The model's own forecast when the last value was served instead (fallback rule C10c)

actual_modal_price.title: Actual Modal Price
actual_modal_price.description: The reported price on that date, once known (unflagged primary value)

issued_on.title: Issued On
issued_on.description: Forecast origin: inputs are reports dated on or before this Monday

model.description: null when no valid model existed and the last value was served

served_by.title: Served By
served_by.description: Method per day range: model or last_value

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: Fallback decisions (C10c) for the day ranges shown

stopped_reporting.title: Stopped Reporting
stopped_reporting.description: Series whose last report is 15–90 days before the latest date

live.title: Live
live.description: Latest live accuracy per day range (published forecasts only)

checked_at.title: Checked At
checked_at.description: When the last monitor job ran (missing-update checks)

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; null on the last page

source_observation_id.title: Source Observation Id
source_observation_id.description: Row in source_observations (the value exactly as received)

position_pct.title: Position Pct
position_pct.description: 0 = at the 52-week low, 100 = at the high

volatility_91_days_pct.title: Volatility 91 Days Pct
volatility_91_days_pct.description: Standard deviation of log changes between consecutive reports over 91 days, in percent

change_pct.title: Change Pct
change_pct.description: Latest price vs the window average, in percent
